crossRefs.note: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…
My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion:
Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

translations.web: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
translations.bsb: So now, my sons, listen to me, and do not turn aside from the words of my mouth.
translations.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
translations.asv: Now therefore, my sons, hearken unto me, And depart not from the words of my mouth.
